subtotal_label: TOTAL 611000 EMPLOYEES (Bureau Of Solid Waste & Recycling: Administration)
evidence: The two 611000 positions print 11,065 + 20,000 = 31,065, but the subtotal is 131,065 (gap 100,000). A clipped leading '1' on either salary closes the gap, so the arithmetic allows 120,000 or 111,065. Other books rule out 111,065 for DEP DIRECTOR PW OPERATIONS & CONST (0.08 FTE): it is 10,743 (2022), 12,000 (2024) and 12,360 (2025). The 1.00-FTE manager of this unit is 88,751 (2022) and 115,000 (2024), consistent with 120,000. So the manager's salary is corrected to 120,000.
